research_notes.subscriptions.json: STANDARD: 1 request/prompt/message = 1 agentic model call of 20,000 input tokens (18,000 cache-read + 2,000 uncached) + 1,500 output = 21,500 tokens. Window plans: 4 usable 5h windows/day x 30 days = 120 windows/month, then capped by weekly cap x 30/7 and by any monthly cap (whichever binds first). Dollar-pool plans: pool / blended reference rate for the same token mix at Claude Sonnet 5.5 list ($2 in / $0.20 cache-read / $10 out per Mtok) = $1.0512/Mtok. Reference blended rates for the standard mix ($/Mtok): sonnet55=1.0512, opus5=2.6279, glm53=0.6549, gpt61sol=0.9674, gemflash=0.3942, qwen37plus=0.3870, grok47=1.0233. No subscription found for DeepSeek (API only, off-peak discounts) or Groq (API/dev tiers only); Qwen Code free OAuth tier ended 2026-04-15. Lovable/Poe prices not retrievable (JS/403) and omitted.
